title: brain trace: a local record of development
why: `brain run` records requests, payloads, errors at their `.brain` line, CSP and cross-origin failures, so a failure can be read instead of reproduced blind. It never reaches a production build, redacts credentials, and any module can report in one line.
changelog: The capture never reaches a production build

adopt.snippet: globalThis.__brainTrace('payments', 'declined', { level: 'error', title: 'Card declined', fix: 'Ask for another card' })
